arxiv-2107-13007.title: Measurement of Bell-type inequalities and quantum entanglement from Λ \Lambda -hyperon spin correlations at high energy colliders
arxiv-2107-13007.creator: Wenjie Gong, Ganesh Parida, Zhoudunming Tu, Raju Venugopalan
arxiv-2107-13007.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Wenjie Gong, Ganesh Parida, Zhoudunming Tu, Raju Venugopalan. Spin correlations of Λ \Lambda -hyperons embedded in the QCD strings formed in high energy collider experiments provide unique insight into their locality and entanglement features. We show from general considerations that while the Clauser-Horne-Shimony-Holt inequality is less stringent for such states, they provide a benchmark for quantum-to-classical transitions induced by varying i) the associated hadron multiplicity, ii) the spin of nucleons, iii) the separation in rapidity between pairs, and iv) the kinematic regimes accessed.

arxiv-2201-02170.title: Magnetic response properties of twisted bilayer graphene
arxiv-2201-02170.creator: Simon Becker, Jihoi Kim, Xiaowen Zhu
arxiv-2201-02170.description: Abstract . In this article, we analyse the Bistritzer–MacDonald (BM) model (also known as the continuum model) of twisted bilayer graphene (TBG) with an additional external magnetic field. We provide an explicit semiclassical asymptotic expansion of the density of states (DOS) in the limit of strong magnetic fields.

arxiv-2310-05969.title: Automated Chest X-Ray Report Generator Using Multi-Model Deep Learning Approach Thanks: * Corresponding author
arxiv-2310-05969.creator: 1 st Arief Purnama Muharram, 2 nd Hollyana Puteri Haryono, 3 rd Abassi Haji Juma, 4 th Ira Puspasari, 5 th Nugraha Priya Utama *
arxiv-2310-05969.description: Abstract Reading and interpreting chest X-ray images is one of the most radiologist’s routines. However, it still can be challenging, even for the most experienced ones. Therefore, we proposed a multi-model deep learning-based automated chest X-ray report generator system designed to assist radiologists in their work.

arxiv-2504-11316.title: Role of Matter Inhomogeneity on Fast Flavor Conversion of Supernova Neutrinos
arxiv-2504-11316.creator: Soumya Bhattacharyya, Meng-Ru Wu, Zewei Xiong
arxiv-2504-11316.description: Abstract We study how a spatially varying matter potential λ \lambda , arising from neutrino–electron forward scattering, affects the onset, evolution, and nonlinear outcome of fast neutrino flavor conversions (FFCs) triggered by the presence of zero crossings in the angular distribution of the neutrino electron lepton number (ELN).

arxiv-2504-16230.title: Robust Causal Inference for EHR-based Studies of Point Exposures with Missingness in Eligibility Criteria
arxiv-2504-16230.creator: Luke Benz, Rajarshi Mukherjee, Rui Wang, David Arterburn, Heidi Fischer, Catherine Lee, Susan M. Shortreed, Sebastien Haneuse*, Alexander W. Levis*
arxiv-2504-16230.description: Abstract Missingness in variables that define study eligibility criteria is a seldom addressed challenge in electronic health record (EHR)-based settings. Patients with incomplete eligibility information are typically excluded from analysis without consideration of the (implicit) assumptions being made, leaving study conclusions subject to potential selection bias.

arxiv-2508-19011.title: STDiff: A State Transition Diffusion Framework for Time Series Imputation in Industrial Systems
arxiv-2508-19011.creator: Gary Simethy, Daniel Ortiz-Arroyo, Petar Durdevic
arxiv-2508-19011.description: Abstract Most deep learning methods for imputing missing values treat the task as completing patterns within a fixed time window. This assumption often fails in industrial systems, where dynamics are driven by control actions, are highly non-stationary, and can experience long, uninterrupted gaps.

arxiv-2510-18558.title: Flexbee: A Grasping and Perching UAV Based on Soft Vector-Propulsion Nozzle
arxiv-2510-18558.creator: Yue Wang, Lixian Zhang, Yimin Zhu, Yangguang Liu, Xuwei Yang
arxiv-2510-18558.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yue Wang, Lixian Zhang, Yimin Zhu, Yangguang Liu, Xuwei Yang. The aim of this paper is to design a new type of grasping and perching unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV), Flexbee, characterized by its soft vector-propulsion nozzle (SVPN). Compared to previous UAVs, Flexbee integrates flight, grasping, and perching functionalities into the four SVPNs, offering advantages such as decoupled position and attitude control, high structural reuse, and strong adaptability for grasping and perching.

arxiv-2512-14857.title: On the Local Structure and Approximation Stability of Block Isotropic Gaussian Fields
arxiv-2512-14857.creator: Munki Jeong, Alexander Strang
arxiv-2512-14857.description: Abstract Skew-symmetric functions are a class of functions defined on a product space M × M M\times M that are antisymmetric with respect to the order of their inputs. In [ 13 ] , the authors proved that non-deterministic skew-symmetric Gaussian fields cannot be stationary or isotropic and proposed an alternative notion: stationarity (isotropy) in each component space.

pmc-10521502.title: Preliminary study of short-term outcomes and learning curves of robotic-assisted THA: comparison between closed platform robotic system and open platform robotic system
pmc-10521502.creator: Teng-Feng Zhuang, Chong-Jie Wu, Si-Min Luo, Wen-Rui Wu, Jun-Yuan Chen, Zhen-Gang Zha, Song-Wei Huan, Ning Liu
pmc-10521502.description: BackgroundBoth closed platform and open platform robotic-assisted total hip arthroplasty (THA) have recently been recommended as a viable treatment option for achieving accurate positioning of components. Yet, limited studies paid attention to the differences between the closed platform robotic system and the open platform robotic system.

pmc-10587911.title: Precision Medicine Approaches to Diabetic Kidney Disease: Personalized Interventions on the Horizon
pmc-10587911.creator: FNU Nageeta, Fahad Waqar, Ibtesam Allahi, Farhan Murtaza, Muhammad Nasir, FNU Danesh, Beena Irshad, Rajesh Kumar, Arslan Tayyab, Muhammad Saood Moazzam Khan, Satesh Kumar, Giustino Varrassi, Mahima Khatri, Muhammad Ali Muzammil, Tamam Mohamad
pmc-10587911.description: Diabetic kidney disease (DKD) is a significant complication of diabetes that requires innovative interventions to address its increasing impact. Precision medicine is a rapidly emerging paradigm that shows excellent promise in tailoring therapeutic strategies to the unique profiles of individual patients. This abstract examines the potential of precision medicine in managing DKD.

pmc-11484462.title: Leukocytosis and thrombocytosis after splenectomy: expected finding, infection, or something else: a case report
pmc-11484462.creator: Nicolas Gonzalez, Jeffry Nahmias, Lisa X Lee, Matthew Dolich, Michael Lekawa, Allen Kong, Areg Grigorian
pmc-11484462.description: BackgroundLeukocytosis and thrombocytosis often follow splenectomy in blunt trauma patients, complicating the postoperative identification of infection. While the platelet count to white blood cell ratio provides diagnostic assistance to discern between expected laboratory alterations and infection, diagnoses such as leukemia are often overlooked.

pmc-11536543.title: Comparison of three methods for generating the coccoid form of Helicobacter pylori and proteomic analysis
pmc-11536543.creator: Kyoungwon Jung, Haram Bae, Jiyeun Kate Kim, Bohyun Jeong, Moo In Park, Jee Young Lee
pmc-11536543.description: BackgroundHelicobacter pylori changes from spiral to coccoid depending on the host state, environmental factors, and surrounding microbial communities. The coccoid form of H. pylori still maintains its complete cellular structure, retains virulence genes, and thus plays a role in pathogenicity. To understand the coccoid form, it is crucial to establish the in vitro generation of the coccoid H. pylori.

pmc-11690069.title: ARE FEDERAL GUIDELINES HELPING TO IMPROVE PAIN ASSESSMENT, DIAGNOSIS, AND MANAGEMENT IN NURSING HOMES
pmc-11690069.creator: Sorah Levy
pmc-11690069.description: The State Operations Manual for Long Term Care, specifically F-Tag F697, requires that nursing homes must ensure that pain management is provided to residents. The management should be consistent with professional standards of practice, the person-centered care plan, and the residents’ goals and preferences.

pmc-12413739.title: Cerebrovascular Reactivity at Rest and Its Association With Cognitive Function in People With Genetic Frontotemporal Dementia
pmc-12413739.creator: Ivana Kirilova Kancheva, Arabella Bouzigues, Lucy Louise Russell, Phoebe H. Foster, Eve Ferry-Bolder, John C. Van Swieten, Lize Corrine Jiskoot, Harro Seelaar, Raquel Sánchez-Valle, Robert Laforce, Caroline Graff, Daniela Galimberti, Rik Vandenberghe, Alexandre de Mendonça, Pietro Tiraboschi, Isabel
pmc-12413739.description: Background and ObjectivesCerebrovascular reactivity (CVR) is an indicator of cerebrovascular health, and its signature in familial frontotemporal dementia (FTD) remains unknown. The primary aim was to investigate CVR in genetic FTD using an fMRI index of vascular contractility termed resting-state fluctuation amplitudes (RSFAs) and to assess whether RSFA differences are moderated by age.

pmc-12418837.title: Artificial intelligence and computational methods in human metabolism research: A comprehensive survey
pmc-12418837.creator: Manzhan Zhang, Yuxin Wan, Jing Wang, Shiliang Li, Honglin Li
pmc-12418837.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Understanding the metabolism of endogenous and exogenous substances in the human body is essential for elucidating disease mechanisms and evaluating the safety and efficacy of drug candidates during the drug development process. Recent advancements in artificial intelligence (AI), particularly in machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) techniques, have introduced innovative approaches to metabolism research, enabling more accurate predictions and insights.

pmc-12504400.title: Characterization of SPTLC2 as a key driver promoting microglial activation and energy metabolism reprogramming after ischemic stroke through bulk and single-cell analyses combined with experimental validation
pmc-12504400.creator: Yongxing Lai, Peiqiang Lin, Zhiyun Wu, Tin Chen, Wenyao Hong, Mouwei Zheng, Jianhao Chen, Nan Liu, Hongbin Chen
pmc-12504400.description: BackgroundIschemic stroke (IS) stands as a principal contributor to high rates of sickness and death. The condition's pathological development is complicated, featuring mechanisms like mitochondrial impairment and the activation of microglial cells. A thorough grasp of these intricate processes is vital for creating successful treatment strategies.

pmc-12560774.title: Off-label Use of Gastrointestinal Multiplex PCR Panel for the Diagnosis of Amoebic Liver Abscess: A Three-case Pediatric Report
pmc-12560774.creator: Michael Muñoz-Rosa, Natalia Arango-Serna, Juan Mesa-Monsalve, Alejandro Diaz-Diaz
pmc-12560774.description: Diagnosis of amoebic liver abscess is challenging. A multiplex polymerase chain reaction panel, traditionally employed for the detection of enteric pathogens in stool, proved useful for the rapid diagnosis in 3 pediatric patients when used off-label on liver abscess fluid.

pmc-12599767.title: Remnant cholesterol to high density lipoprotein cholesterol ratio is correlated with bone mineral density: Analysis of NHANES 2011–2018
pmc-12599767.creator: Junpeng Qiu, Fangjun Xiao, Yaoxin Ao, Jiangfeng Lv, Muyuan Hou, Aoqi Xu, Yifei Liufu, Junxing Yang
pmc-12599767.description: Emerging evidence suggests that lipid metabolism plays a critical role in bone homeostasis. The ratio of remnant cholesterol/high-density lipoprotein cholesterol (RC/HDL-C) has recently been proposed as a novel indicator of metabolic risk; however, its relationship with bone mineral density (BMD) remains unclear. This study aimed to explore the association between RC/HDL-C and total BMD in a nationally representative population.

pmc-12750872.title: Implementing brain health strategies in primary care: methods and baseline findings from the BHAM registry
pmc-12750872.creator: Pamela G Bowen, Catherine Danielle Jones, Terina Myers, Roy Martin, Amy Knight, Andres Azuero, Tasha Smith, Connor Lancaster, Michael Brewer, Sameera Davuluri, Erin Delaney, Irfan Asif, Ronald M Lazar
pmc-12750872.description: BackgroundManaging modifiable risk factors in early life is associated with reduced risk of cognitive decline, stroke, and dementia later in life. This is especially important in the US Deep South, which has the highest rates of stroke and dementia nationally. While prevention efforts for brain health are gaining attention, they remain limited within primary care settings.

pmc-12855993.title: Harnessing multivalency and FcγRIIB engagement to augment anti-CD27 immunotherapy
pmc-12855993.creator: Marcus A Widdess, Anastasia Pakidi, Hannah J Metcalfe, H T Claude Chan, Tatyana Inzhelevskaya, Chris A Penfold, C Ian Mockridge, Steven G Booth, Sonya James, Sean H Lim, Stephen A Beers, Mark S Cragg, Aymen Al-Shamkhani
pmc-12855993.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Despite significant clinical progress, checkpoint blockade remains limited by variable response rates, resistance, and toxicity. Activating costimulatory receptors offers a promising alternative to enhance anti-tumor immunity. However, there is insufficient understanding of how to mimic physiological membrane-anchored costimulatory ligands. Here, we describe a strategy for developing effective agonists of the costimulatory receptor CD27 by increasing both antibody valency and FcγRIIB engagement.

pmc-13584188.title: Poor prognosis of acute kidney injury superimposed on chronic kidney disease: potential mechanisms, risk factors and novel biomarkers
pmc-13584188.creator: Linmei Gao, Yuming Ding, Yanru Zhao, Yi Chen, Tao Liu, Wentong Lin, Bo Yang
pmc-13584188.description: Acute kidney injury superimposed on chronic kidney disease (acute-on-chronic kidney injury, hereinafter referred to as AoCKI) is a common clinical syndrome with a generally poor prognosis compared to isolated acute kidney injury (AKI). Patients with AoCKI often face significantly heightened mortality, increased dependence on renal replacement therapy (RRT), and reduced likelihood of renal function recovery.
